note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: same units and same change as RFC8955-4.2.2.5-1. RFC 8955 Section 4.2.2.10: "Type 10 component values SHOULD be encoded as 1- or 2-octet quantities (numeric_op len=00 or len=01)." Packet-length emission requires exact one- and two-octet operands at 0/255/256/65535 across the typed, generic, config and text producers, plus recipient forwarding. Single-polarity as annotated, and the shortest width is local policy. Second re-judgement 2026-10-16: TestFlowSpecPreferredNumericEmission's typed packet-length producer is now the test helper packetLengthComponent (plugin types_test.go), which builds FlowMatch{Op: FlowOpEqual, Value: v} through NewFlowNumericComponent(FlowPacketLength, ...). That is byte-for-byte the matches that the deleted NewFlowPacketLengthComponent built at HEAD (plugin types_numeric.go:457-463). The deleted constructor had no non-test caller at HEAD, so no production producer lost coverage. The typed and generic cases now drive the same constructor, and the registered config, text and forwarding producers carry the distinct evidence.
